From the award-winning director of Hotel Rwanda comes a powerful and sweeping epic set during the last days of the Ottoman Empire. Sparks fly when a humble Armenian medical student falls in love with an artist already committed to a renowned and worldly journalist. The Promise stars Oscar Isaac, Charlotte Le Bon, Christian Bale, Daniel Giménez Cacho, Jean Reno, Tom Hollander, Angela Sarafyan, and more, and is directed by Terry George.
